name: Root Visual Enhancements
description: Adds lightweight X visual markers, notification state, sounds, and Tweet PNG actions.

settings.label: Appearance profile
settings.description: Global visual intensity for X/Twitter surfaces and supported milXdy UI.

presetBehavior.overwriteWarning: Applying a visual preset replaces the current appearance profile.

settings.label: App chrome style
settings.description: Global app-window frame style used by supported docked app surfaces.

presetBehavior.overwriteWarning: Applying a visual preset replaces the current app chrome style.

settings.label: App shadows
settings.description: Controls drop shadows on supported milXdy app windows.

settings.label: Post font
settings.description: Font family used for supported X/Twitter post text.

settings.label: Profile picture shape
settings.description: Shape applied to supported profile pictures on X/Twitter surfaces.

settings.label: Square media
settings.description: Square off supported X/Twitter media previews.

settings.label: Notification unread tint
settings.description: Tint unread X/Twitter notifications when Root Visuals are active.

notes: Applies lightweight X/Twitter visual state and notification affordances through the shared scanner and route service.
Page-level visual effects do not render an app window chrome.

hub.shortDescription: Core X visual polish, notification state, sounds, and invoked Tweet PNG affordances.
dataNotes: Reads current X page surfaces only.
localStorageNotes: Uses appearance profile and visual theme settings.

name: Tweet PNG
description: Renders local PNG exports from X share actions when invoked by the user.

settings.label: Include post images
settings.description: Include post media in reviewed Tweet PNG exports.

settings.label: Include quote text
settings.description: Include quoted post text when a Tweet PNG export contains a quote.

settings.label: Include quote images
settings.description: Include quoted post media when a Tweet PNG export contains a quote.

settings.label: Include date
settings.description: Show the visible post date in Tweet PNG exports.

settings.label: Include stats
settings.description: Show visible reply, repost, like, and view counts in Tweet PNG exports.

settings.label: Export border
settings.description: Draw the configured visual border around Tweet PNG exports.

settings.label: Border palette
settings.description: Palette used for Tweet PNG export borders.

notes: Loaded by Root Visuals only after a user chooses the X share-menu Tweet PNG action.
Uses the selected X tweet element supplied by the user-initiated share menu; it is not scanner-delivered or preloaded.
Invoked export UI should use its authored preview/export chrome.

hub.shortDescription: Export a reviewed local PNG from a post share action.
dataNotes: Renders selected post content locally after user action.
localStorageNotes: Uses appearance settings for export styling.

name: Composer Tools
description: Adds lightweight typing helpers to X/Twitter post composers.

settings.label: Composer Tools
settings.description: Convert double dashes to em dashes while typing supported X/Twitter posts.

notes: Runs as a lightweight document input listener for supported X/Twitter post composer textboxes.
Listens only to active post composer input events and ignores DMs, search, native inputs, and textareas.
Composer Tools does not render an app window chrome.

hub.shortDescription: Convert double dashes to em dashes while typing posts.
dataNotes: Reads only the active X/Twitter post composer text around the caret.

name: Remilia Wiki Hyperlinks
description: Links Remilia ecosystem terms on X to local wiki previews.

settings.label: Wiki links
settings.description: Link known Remilia terms on visible X/Twitter surfaces.

settings.label: Wiki previews
settings.description: Show local preview cards for linked wiki terms.

settings.label: Wiki link color
settings.description: Accent color for inline Remilia Wiki links.

settings.label: Limit links per post
settings.description: Cap the number of inline wiki links added to each post.

settings.label: Maximum links
settings.description: Maximum number of inline wiki links added to each post when limits are enabled.

settings.label: Draft workflow
settings.description: Preferred Remilia Wiki drafting workflow prompt mode.

settings.label: Wiki debug mode
settings.description: Show developer diagnostics for wiki link matching.

notes: Scans visible X/Twitter text surfaces and opens Remilia Wiki links or previews through validated wiki URLs.
Inline link and preview surfaces inherit page and wiki-link styling.

hub.shortDescription: Link Remilia ecosystem terms on X to local wiki previews.
dataNotes: Scans visible post text for local term matches.
localStorageNotes: Stores wiki hyperlink settings, aliases, and deny terms.

name: Remilia Wiki
description: Opens Remilia Wiki pages in a docked sidebar surface.

settings.label: Wiki sidebar
settings.description: Show Remilia Wiki in the shared side rail.

notes: The X side-rail app embeds validated Remilia Wiki pages and uses the separate wiki frame script; it is not a general Remilia Wiki app runtime yet.
The sidebar maps shared overlay variables onto the wiki reader shell.

hub.shortDescription: Open Remilia Wiki from the shared side rail and route wiki links into a docked panel.
permissionNotes: Displays pages from wiki.remilia.org and remilia.wiki when opened by the user.
dataNotes: Navigates only to validated Remilia Wiki URLs.
localStorageNotes: Stores sidebar placement and the most recent wiki URL.

name: Post-reading
description: Reads posts aloud and adds a docked playback surface.

settings.label: Post-reading
settings.description: Show read-aloud controls on supported posts and articles.

settings.label: Reading speed
settings.description: Default speech rate for read-aloud playback.

presetBehavior.overwriteWarning: Applying an audio preset can replace reading speed, voice, and playback settings.

settings.label: Reading volume
settings.description: Default speech volume for read-aloud playback.

settings.label: Reading voice
settings.description: Preferred browser speech voice for local read-aloud playback.

presetBehavior.overwriteWarning: Voice choices come from the current browser or operating system and may fall back when a profile pack is used elsewhere.

settings.label: Auto voice
settings.description: Automatically choose a compatible voice when the preferred voice is unavailable.

settings.label: TTS engine
settings.description: Speech engine used for local read-aloud playback.

settings.label: Custom TTS endpoint
settings.description: Advanced endpoint used only when the custom TTS engine is selected.

settings.label: Autoplay next post
settings.description: Continue to the next eligible post after playback finishes.

settings.label: Completion ding
settings.description: Play a short sound when a post finishes reading.

settings.label: Read image text
settings.description: Use packaged local OCR assets to include visible image text when requested.

settings.label: Read link previews
settings.description: Include visible link preview text in read-aloud content.

settings.label: Player position
settings.description: Default location for the compact read-aloud player.

notes: Adds read-aloud controls to X/Twitter post and article surfaces while keeping the player in the shared overlay rail.
Can read validated wiki-frame article text sent from the Wiki sidebar frame; it does not load the full app runtime directly on the wiki host.
The player maps Post-reading variables onto the shared overlay shell.

hub.shortDescription: Read posts aloud from a docked playback surface.
permissionNotes: OCR uses packaged local worker assets when image text is requested.
Full-quote fetching uses public X/Twitter embed, syndication, or tweet HTML fallbacks without browser cookies or session tokens.
dataNotes: Reads selected post text, quote text, and optional image text.
Full-quote fetching may request public X/Twitter tweet context from publish.twitter.com, cdn.syndication.twimg.com, x.com, or twitter.com without active browser-session material.
localStorageNotes: Stores playback, voice, and reader settings.

name: RemiStats
description: Adds RemiStats profile and user metrics to X surfaces.

settings.label: RemiStats badges
settings.description: Show RemiStats profile, post, and poke context on X.

settings.label: Like auto-poke
settings.description: Offer automatic poke behavior after eligible like actions.

settings.label: RemiStats tooltips
settings.description: Show explanatory tooltips for RemiStats profile and post metrics.

settings.label: Metric icons
settings.description: Show RemiStats metric icons on supported X surfaces.

settings.label: Auto-like pokes
settings.description: Offer automatic like behavior for eligible incoming poke actions.

settings.label: RemiStats sounds
settings.description: Audio feedback for RemiStats and poke events.

settings.label: RemiStats sound volume
settings.description: Volume for RemiStats and poke audio feedback.

settings.label: RemiStats backing boxes
settings.description: Show visual backing boxes behind RemiStats badges.

settings.label: Gold poke alerts
settings.description: Use the gold visual treatment for recent incoming poke hints.

settings.label: Poke button placement
settings.description: Where poke actions appear on supported X/Twitter posts.

notes: Adds RemiStats badges and group-chat avatar support on X/Twitter timeline, profile, and Messages surfaces.
Uses routed RemiliaNET and RemiStats service calls for profile, poke, and trophy data; it does not inject into RemiliaNET pages.
Inline badges and tooltips do not render a docked app frame.

hub.shortDescription: Show RemiStats profile, post, and poke context on X.
permissionNotes: Fetches RemiStats and RemiliaNET profile data for visible handles, Remilia profile images for tooltips, and Milady Maker banner images for profile banners.
dataNotes: Sends X handles to the RemiStats API when badge data is needed, may resolve verified PFP owners through Ethereum RPC, loads Remilia profile images from pfp.remilia.net, and background-proxies Milady Maker NFT banner images without account credentials or cookies.
localStorageNotes: Stores badge, poke cooldown, and theme state.

name: Milady Maxxer
description: Applies Max mode styling and optional Milady image detection.

settings.label: Max mode
settings.description: Legacy Maxxer mode key used for on/off behavior as well as Max mode intensity.

presetBehavior.overwriteWarning: Applying a visual preset can change Max mode.

settings.label: Maxxer sounds
settings.description: Audio feedback for Maxxer matching and collection events.

settings.label: Level badges
settings.description: Show local Maxxer level badges on matched accounts.

settings.label: Include RemiStats beetles
settings.description: Treat RemiStats beetle context as eligible Maxxer context.

settings.label: Hide non-matches
settings.description: Minimize posts that are not recognized as Milady or beetle context.

settings.label: Card detail
settings.description: Amount of local Maxxer card detail shown in the app surface.

settings.label: Disable Maxxer visuals
settings.description: Turn off Maxxer visual treatment while preserving stored Maxxer state.

presetBehavior.overwriteWarning: Applying a visual preset can change whether Maxxer visuals are active.

settings.label: Maxxer intensity
settings.description: Visual intensity for Maxxer treatment on matched surfaces.

settings.label: Maxxer shimmer
settings.description: Show shimmer treatment on eligible Maxxer surfaces.

notes: Processes X timeline, profile, notification, and direct-message surfaces for Maxxer matching; RemiliaNET lookups stay background-routed services, not RemiliaNET page injection.
The Maxxer panel keeps its authored native panel style unless a shared chrome preset is selected.

hub.shortDescription: Apply Max mode styling, collection detection, and the Maxxer side panel.
permissionNotes: Runs packaged ONNX model assets for optional image detection.
dataNotes: Processes visible profile/avatar/media images locally and may check cached Remilia identity, RemiStats beetle, and verified PFP owner context.
localStorageNotes: Stores matched accounts, collected avatars, local player stats, and settings.

name: Beetol
description: Adds the Beetol RemiStats game overlay.

settings.label: Beetol
settings.description: Show the Beetol game in the shared side rail.

settings.label: Beetol color
settings.description: Accent color for Beetol controls and app state.

settings.label: Beetol panel theme
settings.description: Default Beetol panel theme for the app surface.

notes: Uses the browser RemiliaNET session through routed background services after user interaction; no RemiliaNET content-script runtime loads today.
Beetol has its own color and light/dark mode controls; shared classic support should preserve those accents.

hub.shortDescription: Play the Beetol RemiStats game from the shared side rail.
permissionNotes: Uses the browser RemiliaNET session for authenticated game actions.
dataNotes: Sends Beetol action requests to RemiliaNET after user interaction.
localStorageNotes: Stores Beetol enablement, mode, color, and cooldown state.

name: RemiNet Chat
description: Provides a docked RemiliaNET chat client and X messages integration.

settings.label: RemiNet Chat
settings.description: Use RemiliaNET chat from the shared side rail and X messages routes.

settings.label: Chat sounds
settings.description: Audio feedback for RemiNet Chat events.

settings.label: Chat sound volume
settings.description: Volume for RemiNet Chat audio feedback.

settings.label: Sent-message sounds
settings.description: Play audio feedback for sent chat messages.

settings.label: Incoming-message sounds
settings.description: Play audio feedback for incoming chat messages.

notes: Mounts the shared RemiNet Chat overlay into X Messages routes while preserving the side-rail app surface.
Uses RemiliaNET HTTP and WebSocket services through background routing and the browser session; it does not inject the app runtime into RemiliaNET pages yet.
RemiNet Chat is the reference RemiNet chrome surface.

hub.shortDescription: Use RemiliaNET chat from the side rail and X messages routes.
permissionNotes: Uses the browser RemiliaNET session and a background WebSocket port.
dataNotes: Sends chat reads, sends, reactions, RemiliaNET media fetches, pfp.remilia.net avatar fetches, and profile lookups to RemiliaNET.
localStorageNotes: Stores chat enablement, profile cache, layout, and sound settings.

name: Miladychan Portal
description: Browses public Miladychan boards and threads from the shared side rail.

settings.label: Miladychan Portal
settings.description: Show the Miladychan board browser in the shared side rail.

notes: Fetches public Miladychan board and thread JSON through a routed background service for the X side-rail portal; no Miladychan content-script runtime loads today.
The portal keeps board-browser affordances while mapping shell colors to shared chrome variables.

hub.shortDescription: Browse public Miladychan boards and threads from the shared side rail.
permissionNotes: Fetches public board and thread JSON when opened.
dataNotes: Requests selected board and thread data from Miladychan.
localStorageNotes: Stores panel layout and theme settings.

name: Music
description: Indexes local music, enriches ISRCs, and manages playlists/radio.

settings.label: Music
settings.description: Show the local music app in the shared side rail.

settings.label: Music volume
settings.description: Playback volume for the local music app.

settings.label: Auto-accept ISRC matches
settings.description: Accept high-confidence enrichment matches without opening the review step.

notes: The music app keeps its authored playback/library chrome unless a shared preset is selected.

hub.shortDescription: Index local music, enrich ISRCs, and manage playlists and radio.
permissionNotes: Requires user-selected local folder access for music indexing.
dataNotes: Reads selected local audio files and may send fingerprints or metadata to enrichment services when configured.
localStorageNotes: Stores music library metadata, playlists, layout, volume, and enrichment settings.
